title: A は B ほど～ない (A wa B hodo ~ nai)
shortExplanation: Expressing that A is not as ~ as B; 'not as...as'
longExplanation: The A は B ほど～ない grammar point is used to express that A is not as ~ as B in some aspect. It can be translated as 'not as...as' in English. This structure is commonly used with い-adjectives (without い) and な-adjective. For verbs, you can use the negative potential form.
formation: A は B ほど + い-Adjective stem (without い) + くない, な-Adjective + じゃない, Verb-negative potential form

examples.jp: 山田さんは鈴木さんほど背が高くない。
examples.romaji: Yamada-san wa Suzuki-san hodo se ga takakunai.
examples.en: Yamada is not as tall as Suzuki.

examples.jp: このリンゴはあのリンゴほど甘くない。
examples.romaji: Kono ringo wa ano ringo hodo amakunai.
examples.en: This apple is not as sweet as that apple.

examples.jp: 彼は私ほど勉強ができない。
examples.romaji: Kare wa watashi hodo benkyou ga dekinai.
examples.en: He can't study as well as I can.

examples.jp: このレストランはあのレストランほど静かじゃない。
examples.romaji: Kono resutoran wa ano resutoran hodo shizuka janai.
examples.en: This restaurant is not as quiet as that restaurant.
